messages:
maria: Quick heads-up  Quickstart Lab next Thursday. Need: short launch post, microbench blurb (cache + quant focus), 30m live lab, and inbound routing. Who owns what?
dan: I can do the launch post + 2 social snippets. Keep it ~130 words, include repo link, quickstart, 3 callouts (easy local deploy, predictable tail lat, cost levers).
eden: Ill run the microbench and write the short narrative. Plan: cache hit vs miss (p95), batching on vs off (cost delta), and a tiny quant comparison. Percent improvements only.
ops-bot: Provisioned demo cluster: demo-quickstart-2026 (3xA10G, 1xjumpbox). URL: https://demo.redwood.ai/quickstart/v0.9. Read-only token issued. Expires 72h after launch.
design: Ill produce two social cards (card+bench highlight). Need final hero line by Tue noon.
jamie: Webinar: Thu 10:00 PT, 30m (10m intro, 10m hands-on, 8m bench walk, 2m Qs). I can host + moderate.
maria: Routing: tag leads "quickstart-lab-v0.9". High intent = attended + demo-click -> AE queue D. Others -> 7-day nurture. Add boolean field "want-hands-on" to scoring.
dan: For the post, hero metric proposal: "~3.5x lower p95 with KV cache on common prompts"  Eden to validate.
eden: Ill confirm tonight. Will attach a 3-row summary (p50/p95/cost-per-1k) with percent deltas.
maria: Include a tiny reproducible bench snippet in the post (<=4 lines).
eden: Draft snippet:
```
# cache vs no-cache
wrk -t2 -c100 -d20s --latency https://demo.redwood.ai/quickstart/v0.9/generate
# quant smoke test
python bench/quick_quant.py --model quickstart_v0.9 --seq 256
```
jamie: Can ops open the cluster for a dry-run Mon 06:00 PT? Also need a staging registration page.
ops-bot: Dry-run cluster ready Mon 06:00 PT. Staging page URL: https://events.redwood.ai/quickstart-v0.9/staging.
design: Drafts uploaded to /assets/quickstart-card-1.png and -2.png. Please review before Tue noon.
dan: Ill PR the post + social copy by Wed EOD. Maria, can you confirm email subject lines?
maria: Yes: Announcement: "Quickstart Lab: Ship a private refapp in 30m"; Reminder: "Tomorrow: live lab + reproducible benches".
jamie: Volunteer moderators for hands-on? @eden can help with bench Qs during lab.
eden: Happy to moderate bench segment.
maria: Final owners: dan=post+social, eden=bench+metrics+moderator, jamie=webinar+moderation, design=cards, ops-bot=infra. Check-in Tue 09:30 PT. Any blockers?
den: None here. Will post CSV and small summary by Tue EOD.
ops-bot: Reminder: use demo token only. Do not expose secrets during demo.
maria: Thanks all :sparkles: Lets keep the post short, reproducible, and action-oriented."
